One thing that clients might not like: the intent kit "dirties" up the root folder with extra folders and documents specific to the intent kit, and would have collisions if there were other folders by the same name, mixing intent kit documents with documents from other stacks if they are present.  I am thinking maybe put everything (except the link from CLAUDE.md) into a folder called `intent-kit/` so that the project files don't get mixed and cluttered.
